# list-table-options

Opt-in table behaviour of a list: remembered search/sort/filters, one reset button, column picker with hidden columns, row density, server-side groups with sums, a totals row and a number range facet.

## README

# List table options

Opt-in table behaviour for entity, projection and related lists. A list without
the `table` block renders and behaves as before.

## What it shows

- `table.rememberState`: search, sort, page size, facets and date range survive
  leaving and re-entering the list within the browser session.
- `table.resetAll`: one button resets everything that differs from the defaults.
- `table.columnPicker`: the view menu lets the user hide and reorder columns;
  `hidden: true` on a column starts it hidden.
- `table.density`: row density default and an optional user choice.
- `table.pinning`: the user pins columns left or right in the view menu;
  `pinned: "left"` on a column starts it pinned.
- `table.resizing`: columns can be resized (table-layout fixed); `width` and
  `minWidth` on a column are start values in px.
- `table.keyboardNavigation`: rows are one tab stop, arrow keys move between rows,
  Space selects the focused row.
- `table.export`: an Export button downloads the whole filtered list as an XLSX
  file; `maxRows` lowers the default limit of 10000 rows.
  Reference columns export their label and timestamps use the browser time zone.
- `bulkActions`: row checkboxes and a selection bar. "Delete" runs the delete
  row action once per selected row (done tasks are skipped); "Set status" opens
  an actionForm once for the whole selection. Its `taskIds` field is a
  `multiSelect` with `display: "count"`, and the `task:set-status` handler
  updates every id in one write, bounded by `.max(MAX_BULK_SELECTION)` and
  reading each id through the tenant-scoped executor. The form has a `preview`:
  the `task:set-status-preview` query returns the affected tasks with old and
  new status from the same plan function the handler applies.
- `table.grouping`: the server groups the list by status; each header shows the
  group's count and estimate sum, "done" starts collapsed and the view menu
  offers grouping by priority or none.
- `table.totals`: a footer row with the estimate sum over the filtered list.
- `facets.estimateHours: { display: "range" }`: from/to inputs for a number field.
- `mutedRowField: "parked"`: a parked task is drawn entirely in the muted colour.
- `toolbarSort: true`: the desktop "Sorted by" select in the filter row (opt-in).
- Column options: `ellipsis` (one truncated line), `multiline` (line breaks stay),
  `tone: "muted"`, `cardAbove` (phone card line above the title), `hideWhenDocked`,
  `emptyPlaceholder` (`false` keeps the cell blank, a string shows muted text),
  `cardBadge` (phone-card pill), `dateOnlyAfterDays` on a timestamp column,
  `pillField` / `pillToneField` (a second pill beside the cell value).
- Row action `display: "text"`: muted text without a button, shown for done tasks.
- `hideCountFooter` is not set here: no screen declaration reaches it (relatedList sets it itself).
- The same block on a `projectionList`, and `task:workload`, a hand-written list
  query that keeps grouping and totals by accepting `aggregate`
  (`entityListSchema`) and answering it with `answerListAggregate`.

## Source

Feature entry point: `src/feature.ts`.

## Tests

```bash
cd samples/recipes/list-table-options
bun test
```

The test boots the feature through the boot validator and checks that a
misspelled key, a hidden column without the picker, an unknown density, a pinned column
without `pinning`, a width without `resizing` and a bulk action on a navigate
row action, a form bulk action whose `idsField` is no count list and a preview over an unknown query or field are rejected.
`workload.integration.test.ts` runs the hand-written query over HTTP and checks
the grouped sums and the filtered total, the preview query, and the handler's unknown-id and over-cap rejections.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import {
  createRegistry,
  defineFeature,
  validateBoot as validateBootRaw,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import type { ListTableOptions } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/ui-types";
import { withBootValidatorFixture } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/helpers";
import * as z from "zod";
import { createTaskBoardFeature, openAccess, taskEntity } from "../feature";

// The boot validator is the net for blocks the type system never sees (JS, generated features).
function featureWithBlock(block: object) {
  return createTaskBoardFeature(block as ListTableOptions);
}

function validateBoot(features: Parameters<typeof validateBootRaw>[0]): void {
  validateBootRaw(withBootValidatorFixture(features));
}

describe("list-table-options recipe", () => {
  test("the full table block boots and reaches the registered screen", () => {
    const feature = createTaskBoardFeature();
    expect(() => validateBoot([feature])).not.toThrow();
    const screen = createRegistry([feature]).getScreen("task-board:screen:task-list");
    expect(screen?.type === "entityList" ? screen.table : undefined).toEqual({
      rememberState: true,
      resetAll: true,
      columnPicker: true,
      density: { default: "comfortable", userChoice: true },
      pinning: true,
      resizing: true,
      keyboardNavigation: true,
      export: { xlsx: true, maxRows: 5000 },
      grouping: { field: "status", collapsedWhen: "done", userChoice: true, fields: ["priority"] },
      totals: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }],
    });
  });

  test("the bulk actions resolve to the delete row action and the status form", () => {
    const screen = createRegistry([createTaskBoardFeature()]).getScreen(
      "task-board:screen:task-list",
    );
    expect(screen?.type === "entityList" ? screen.bulkActions : undefined).toEqual([
      { id: "delete", rowAction: "delete" },
      {
        id: "set-status",
        label: "Set status",
        icon: "edit",
        screen: "task-set-status",
        idsField: "taskIds",
      },
    ]);
  });

  test("the form bulk action boots and a missing count field is rejected", () => {
    expect(() => validateBoot([createTaskBoardFeature()])).not.toThrow();
    const feature = defineFeature("bulk-form-bad", (r) => {
      r.crud("task", taskEntity, { write: openAccess, read: openAccess });
      r.screen({
        id: "task-list",
        type: "entityList",
        entity: "task",
        columns: ["title"],
        bulkActions: [{ id: "set", label: "Set", screen: "set-form", idsField: "taskIds" }],
        access: openAccess.access,
      });
      r.screen({
        id: "set-form",
        type: "actionForm",
        dormant: true,
        handler: "bulk-form-bad:write:task:create",
        fields: { taskIds: { type: "text" } },
        layout: { sections: [{ fields: ["taskIds"] }] },
      });
    });
    expect(() => validateBoot([feature])).toThrow(/idsField "taskIds", which is not a list field/);
  });

  test("a preview over an unknown query or an undeclared field is rejected", () => {
    const withPreview = (preview: object) =>
      defineFeature("preview-bad", (r) => {
        r.queryHandler({
          name: "task:p",
          schema: z.object({ status: z.string().optional() }),
          handler: async () => ({ count: 0 }),
          access: openAccess.access,
        });
        r.writeHandler({
          name: "task:noop",
          schema: z.object({ status: z.string() }),
          handler: async () => ({ isSuccess: true as const, data: {} }),
          access: openAccess.access,
        });
        r.screen({
          id: "noop-form",
          type: "actionForm",
          dormant: true,
          handler: "preview-bad:write:task:noop",
          fields: { status: { type: "text" } },
          layout: { sections: [{ fields: ["status"] }] },
          preview: { facts: [{ field: "count", label: "Count" }], ...preview },
        } as never);
      });
    expect(() => validateBoot([withPreview({ query: "preview-bad:query:task:missing" })])).toThrow(
      /Screen "noop-form" \(actionForm\) preview/,
    );
    expect(() =>
      validateBoot([withPreview({ query: "preview-bad:query:task:p", fields: ["owner"] })]),
    ).toThrow(/sends field "owner"/);
  });

  test("a bulk action that points at a navigate row action is rejected", () => {
    const feature = defineFeature("bulk-on-navigate", (r) => {
      r.crud("task", taskEntity, { write: openAccess, read: openAccess });
      r.screen({
        id: "task-list",
        type: "entityList",
        entity: "task",
        columns: ["title"],
        rowActions: [{ kind: "navigate", id: "open", label: "Open", screen: "task-list" }],
        bulkActions: [{ id: "open", rowAction: "open" }],
        access: openAccess.access,
      });
    });
    expect(() => validateBoot([feature])).toThrow(
      /bulk action "open" points at rowAction "open" of kind "navigate"/,
    );
  });

  test("a pinned column needs table.pinning", () => {
    expect(() => validateBoot([featureWithBlock({ columnPicker: true, resizing: true })])).toThrow(
      /column "title" is pinned but table\.pinning is not enabled/,
    );
  });

  test("width and minWidth need table.resizing", () => {
    expect(() => validateBoot([featureWithBlock({ columnPicker: true, pinning: true })])).toThrow(
      /column "title" sets width but table\.resizing is not enabled/,
    );
  });

  test("a misspelled table key is rejected with the allowed keys", () => {
    expect(() => validateBoot([featureWithBlock({ rememberStatee: true })])).toThrow(
      /unknown key\(s\) "rememberStatee"\. Allowed keys: rememberState, resetAll, columnPicker, density, pinning, resizing, keyboardNavigation, export/,
    );
  });

  // A hidden column that backs a facet needs no picker (the facet is its UI), so the recipe's
  // own hidden estimateHours column does not trip the rule; a plain hidden column does.
  test("a hidden column without a facet needs the column picker", () => {
    const feature = defineFeature("task-board", (r) => {
      r.crud("task", taskEntity, { write: openAccess, read: openAccess });
      r.screen({
        id: "task-list",
        type: "entityList",
        entity: "task",
        columns: ["title", { field: "assignee", hidden: true }],
        table: { rememberState: true },
      });
    });
    expect(() => validateBoot([feature])).toThrow(
      /column "assignee" is hidden but table\.columnPicker is not enabled/,
    );
  });

  test("a density outside the union is rejected", () => {
    expect(() =>
      validateBoot([featureWithBlock({ columnPicker: true, density: { default: "tight" } })]),
    ).toThrow(/table\.density\.default is "tight"/);
  });

  test("an export row limit above the hard cap is rejected", () => {
    expect(() =>
      validateBoot([
        featureWithBlock({ columnPicker: true, export: { xlsx: true, maxRows: 100001 } }),
      ]),
    ).toThrow(/table\.export\.maxRows is 100001 .* at most 100000/);
  });
});
```

### src/__tests__/workload.integration.test.ts

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { createTestUser, testTenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { MAX_BULK_SELECTION } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/ui-types";
import { setupTestStack, type TestStack } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { createTaskBoardFeature } from "../feature";

type ListAggregateResult = {
  readonly groups: readonly { key: unknown; count: number; measures: readonly unknown[] }[];
};

let stack: TestStack;
const user = createTestUser({ roles: ["User"], tenantId: testTenantId(1) });

const TASKS = [
  { title: "Quarterly VAT filing", assignee: "Ines", estimateHours: 6 },
  { title: "Prepare audit", assignee: "Ines", estimateHours: 24 },
  { title: "Plan offsite", assignee: "Mara", estimateHours: 7 },
] as const;

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({ features: [createTaskBoardFeature()], systemHooks: [] });
  for (const task of TASKS) {
    await stack.http.writeOk("task-board:write:task:create", task, user);
  }
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

describe("hand-written list query with aggregate", () => {
  test("groups by assignee with the server count and estimate sum", async () => {
    const result = await stack.http.queryOk<ListAggregateResult>(
      "task-board:query:task:workload",
      { aggregate: { groupBy: "assignee", measures: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }] } },
      user,
    );
    expect(result.groups.map(({ key, count, measures }) => ({ key, count, measures }))).toEqual([
      { key: "Ines", count: 2, measures: [30] },
      { key: "Mara", count: 1, measures: [7] },
    ]);
  });

  test("the totals answer follows the list filter", async () => {
    const result = await stack.http.queryOk<ListAggregateResult>(
      "task-board:query:task:workload",
      {
        filters: [{ field: "estimateHours", op: "lte", value: 7 }],
        aggregate: { measures: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }] },
      },
      user,
    );
    expect(result.groups.map((group) => group.measures)).toEqual([[13]]);
  });

  test("without aggregate the same query lists rows", async () => {
    const list = await stack.http.queryOk<{ rows: { title: string }[] }>(
      "task-board:query:task:workload",
      { sort: "title" },
      user,
    );
    expect(list.rows.map((row) => row.title)).toEqual([
      "Plan offsite",
      "Prepare audit",
      "Quarterly VAT filing",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("form bulk action handler", () => {
  test("one write sets the status of every selected task", async () => {
    const created = await Promise.all(
      ["Bulk A", "Bulk B"].map((title) =>
        stack.http.writeOk<{ data: { id: string } }>(
          "task-board:write:task:create",
          { title },
          user,
        ),
      ),
    );
    const taskIds = created.map((task) => task.data.id);
    await stack.http.writeOk(
      "task-board:write:task:set-status",
      { taskIds, status: "blocked", note: "waiting" },
      user,
    );
    const list = await stack.http.queryOk<{
      rows: { title: string; status: string; note: string }[];
    }>("task-board:query:task:list", { sort: "title" }, user);
    expect(
      list.rows.filter((row) => row.title.startsWith("Bulk")).map((row) => [row.status, row.note]),
    ).toEqual([
      ["blocked", "waiting"],
      ["blocked", "waiting"],
    ]);
  });

  test("the preview query shows the same plan the handler applies", async () => {
    const created = await Promise.all(
      ["Plan A", "Plan B"].map((title) =>
        stack.http.writeOk<{ data: { id: string } }>(
          "task-board:write:task:create",
          { title, status: title === "Plan B" ? "blocked" : "open" },
          user,
        ),
      ),
    );
    const taskIds = created.map((task) => task.data.id);
    const preview = await stack.http.queryOk<{
      count: number;
      tasks: { title: string; before: string; after: string }[];
    }>("task-board:query:task:set-status-preview", { taskIds, status: "blocked" }, user);
    expect(preview).toEqual({
      count: 1,
      tasks: [
        { title: "Plan A", before: "open", after: "blocked" },
        { title: "Plan B", before: "blocked", after: "blocked" },
      ],
    });
  });

  test("an unknown id fails the whole write and a list above the cap is rejected", async () => {
    const unknown = await stack.http.write(
      "task-board:write:task:set-status",
      { taskIds: ["11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"], status: "done" },
      user,
    );
    const unknownBody = (await unknown.json()) as { isSuccess: boolean; error?: { code: string } };
    expect(unknownBody.isSuccess).toBe(false);
    expect(unknownBody.error?.code).toBe("not_found");

    const tooMany = await stack.http.write(
      "task-board:write:task:set-status",
      {
        taskIds: Array.from({ length: MAX_BULK_SELECTION + 1 }, () => crypto.randomUUID()),
        status: "done",
      },
      user,
    );
    const tooManyBody = (await tooMany.json()) as { isSuccess: boolean; error?: { code: string } };
    expect(tooManyBody.isSuccess).toBe(false);
    expect(tooManyBody.error?.code).toBe("validation_error");
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
import {
  answerListAggregate,
  buildEntityTable,
  createEventStoreExecutor,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
import {
  createBooleanField,
  createDateField,
  createEntity,
  createNumberField,
  createSelectField,
  createTextField,
  createTimestampField,
  defineFeature,
  entityListSchema,
  type FeatureDefinition,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { failNotFound, NotFoundError } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/errors";
import { type ListTableOptions, MAX_BULK_SELECTION } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/ui-types";
import { z } from "zod";

export const taskEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_list_table_tasks",
  fields: {
    title: createTextField({
      personal: false,
      reason: "is_business_data",
      required: true,
      searchable: true,
      sortable: true,
    }),
    status: createSelectField({
      options: ["open", "inProgress", "blocked", "done"] as const,
      default: "open",
      sortable: true,
      filterable: true,
    }),
    priority: createSelectField({
      options: ["low", "medium", "high"] as const,
      default: "medium",
      sortable: true,
      filterable: true,
    }),
    dueDate: createDateField({ sortable: true }),
    assignee: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", sortable: true }),
    estimateHours: createNumberField({ sortable: true, filterable: true }),
    parked: createBooleanField({ default: false }),
    note: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data" }),
    team: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data" }),
    teamTone: createSelectField({
      options: ["positive", "warn", "negative", "neutral"] as const,
      default: "neutral",
    }),
    lastUpdate: createTimestampField({ sortable: true }),
  },
});

export const openAccess = {
  access: {
    openToAll: { reason: "recipe: any signed-in user manages the tasks; no per-user ownership" },
  },
} as const;

const setStatusInput = z.object({
  taskIds: z.array(z.uuid()).min(1).max(MAX_BULK_SELECTION),
  status: z.enum(taskEntity.fields.status.options),
});

type StatusPlanRow = {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly version: number;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly before: string;
  readonly after: string;
};

// The one rule behind the status form: the write handler applies it and the preview query shows it.
async function planStatusChanges(
  taskIds: readonly string[],
  status: string,
  loadTask: (id: string) => Promise<Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | null | undefined>,
): Promise<{ readonly rows: readonly StatusPlanRow[] } | { readonly missingId: string }> {
  const rows: StatusPlanRow[] = [];
  for (const id of taskIds) {
    const task = await loadTask(id);
    if (!task) return { missingId: id };
    rows.push({
      id,
      version: Number(task["version"]),
      title: String(task["title"]),
      before: String(task["status"]),
      after: status,
    });
  }
  return { rows };
}
// Overridable so a test can feed the boot validator a block that must be rejected.
export function createTaskBoardFeature(
  taskTable: ListTableOptions = {
    rememberState: true,
    resetAll: true,
    columnPicker: true,
    density: { default: "comfortable", userChoice: true },
    pinning: true,
    resizing: true,
    keyboardNavigation: true,
    export: { xlsx: true, maxRows: 5000 },
    grouping: { field: "status", collapsedWhen: "done", userChoice: true, fields: ["priority"] },
    totals: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }],
  },
): FeatureDefinition {
  return defineFeature("task-board", (r) => {
    r.crud("task", taskEntity, { write: openAccess, read: openAccess });

    r.screen({
      id: "task-list",
      type: "entityList",
      entity: "task",
      columns: [
        // Starts pinned left; width and minWidth are start values for resizing.
        { field: "title", pinned: "left", width: 280, minWidth: 160 },
        "status",
        // The phone card shows the priority as its outlined pill instead of the first select column.
        { field: "priority", cardBadge: true },
        { field: "dueDate", hideOnNarrow: true },
        // The team pill sits beside the assignee name; its tone comes from the row.
        {
          field: "assignee",
          hideOnNarrow: true,
          pillField: "team",
          pillToneField: "teamTone",
          emptyPlaceholder: "Unassigned",
        },
        // One truncated line in the table; a line break starts a new line on the phone card.
        {
          field: "note",
          ellipsis: true,
          multiline: true,
          tone: "muted",
          cardAbove: true,
          hideWhenDocked: true,
          emptyPlaceholder: false,
        },
        // Recent edits show date and time, older ones the date only.
        { field: "lastUpdate", dateOnlyAfterDays: 7, hideOnNarrow: true },
        // Starts hidden; the user can add it back in the view menu.
        { field: "estimateHours", hidden: true, hideOnNarrow: true },
      ],
      facets: { status: { display: "chips" }, priority: {}, estimateHours: { display: "range" } },
      defaultSort: { field: "dueDate", dir: "asc" },
      searchable: true,
      table: taskTable,
      mutedRowField: "parked",
      toolbarSort: true,
      sortOptions: [
        { field: "dueDate", dir: "asc", label: "Due date" },
        { field: "priority", dir: "desc", label: "Priority" },
      ],
      rowActions: [
        // A closed state as muted text instead of a button.
        {
          kind: "navigate",
          id: "closed",
          label: "Closed",
          screen: "task-edit",
          display: "text",
          visible: { field: "status", eq: "done" },
        },
        { kind: "navigate", id: "open", label: "Open", screen: "task-edit", rowClick: true },
        {
          kind: "writeHandler",
          id: "delete",
          label: "Delete",
          handler: "task-board:write:task:delete",
          style: "danger",
          // Done tasks are skipped by the bulk run and counted as skipped.
          visible: { field: "status", ne: "done" },
        },
      ],
      // Row checkboxes and a selection bar; delete writes once per row, set-status once for all.
      bulkActions: [
        { id: "delete", rowAction: "delete" },
        {
          id: "set-status",
          label: "Set status",
          icon: "edit",
          screen: "task-set-status",
          idsField: "taskIds",
        },
      ],
      access: openAccess.access,
    });

    r.screen({
      id: "task-edit",
      type: "entityEdit",
      entity: "task",
      dormant: true,
      listScreenId: "task-list",
      layout: {
        sections: [
          {
            columns: 2,
            fields: ["title", "assignee", "status", "priority", "dueDate", "estimateHours"],
          },
        ],
      },
    });

    // The same block works on a list over any query.
    r.queryHandler({
      name: "task:overdue",
      schema: z.object({}),
      handler: async () => ({
        rows: [{ id: "t1", title: "Quarterly VAT filing", assignee: "Ines", daysLate: 3 }],
        nextCursor: null,
      }),
      access: openAccess.access,
      outputSchema: z.object({
        rows: z.array(
          z.object({
            id: z.string(),
            title: z.string(),
            assignee: z.string(),
            daysLate: z.number(),
          }),
        ),
        nextCursor: z.string().nullable(),
      }),
    });

    r.screen({
      id: "task-overdue",
      type: "projectionList",
      query: "task-board:query:task:overdue",
      columns: ["title", "assignee", "daysLate"],
      table: { rememberState: true, density: { userChoice: true } },
    });

    // A hand-written list query keeps grouping and totals when it accepts
    // `aggregate` (entityListSchema carries it) and answers it on the server.
    const taskExecutor = createEventStoreExecutor(
      buildEntityTable("task", taskEntity),
      taskEntity,
      {
        entityName: "task",
      },
    );
    r.queryHandler({
      name: "task:workload",
      schema: entityListSchema,
      handler: async (query, ctx) => {
        const parentVisibility = { entities: ctx.registry.getAllEntities() };
        const listPayload = query.payload;
        if (listPayload.aggregate !== undefined) {
          return answerListAggregate(
            taskExecutor,
            { ...listPayload, aggregate: listPayload.aggregate },
            query.user,
            ctx.db,
            { parentVisibility },
            {
              entity: taskEntity,
              resolveEntity: (name) => ctx.registry.getEntity(name),
              viewer: { user: query.user, parentVisibility },
            },
          );
        }
        return taskExecutor.list(listPayload, query.user, ctx.db, { parentVisibility });
      },
      access: openAccess.access,
    });

    r.screen({
      id: "task-workload",
      type: "projectionList",
      query: "task-board:query:task:workload",
      columns: ["title", "assignee", "status", "estimateHours"],
      defaultSort: { field: "title", dir: "asc" },
      table: {
        grouping: { field: "assignee" },
        totals: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }],
      },
    });

    // One write for the whole selection: the bulk action below opens this form and `taskIds`
    // arrives as a string array. The client cap is no protection, so the schema bounds the list
    // and every id is read through the tenant-scoped executor before anything is written.
    r.writeHandler({
      name: "task:set-status",
      schema: setStatusInput.extend({ note: z.string().optional() }),
      access: openAccess.access,
      handler: async (event, ctx) => {
        const { taskIds, status, note } = event.payload;
        const plan = await planStatusChanges(taskIds, status, (id) =>
          taskExecutor.detail({ id }, event.user, ctx.db),
        );
        if ("missingId" in plan) return failNotFound("task", plan.missingId);
        const changed = plan.rows.filter((row) => row.before !== row.after);
        for (const row of changed) {
          const result = await taskExecutor.update(
            { id: row.id, version: row.version, changes: { status, note } },
            event.user,
            ctx.db,
          );
          if (!result.isSuccess) return result;
        }
        return { isSuccess: true as const, data: { count: changed.length } };
      },
    });

    // The preview runs the same plan the write handler runs, so the two cannot drift apart.
    r.queryHandler({
      name: "task:set-status-preview",
      schema: setStatusInput,
      access: openAccess.access,
      handler: async (query, ctx) => {
        const { taskIds, status } = query.payload;
        const plan = await planStatusChanges(taskIds, status, (id) =>
          taskExecutor.detail({ id }, query.user, ctx.db),
        );
        if ("missingId" in plan) throw new NotFoundError("task");
        return {
          count: plan.rows.filter((row) => row.before !== row.after).length,
          tasks: plan.rows.map(({ title, before, after }) => ({ title, before, after })),
        };
      },
    });

    r.screen({
      id: "task-set-status",
      type: "actionForm",
      dormant: true,
      handler: "task-board:write:task:set-status",
      listScreenId: "task-list",
      redirect: "task-list",
      fields: {
        taskIds: { type: "multiSelect", options: [], display: "count" },
        status: createSelectField({
          options: ["open", "inProgress", "blocked", "done"] as const,
          required: true,
        }),
        note: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data" }),
      },
      layout: { sections: [{ fields: ["taskIds", "status", "note"] }] },
      // Which tasks change and from what to what, shown before the user submits.
      preview: {
        query: "task-board:query:task:set-status-preview",
        fields: ["taskIds", "status"],
        title: "Preview",
        facts: [{ field: "count", label: "Tasks that change" }],
        list: {
          field: "tasks",
          columns: [
            { field: "title", label: "Task" },
            { field: "before", label: "Now" },
            { field: "after", label: "New" },
          ],
        },
      },
    });

    r.nav({ id: "tasks", label: "task-board:nav.tasks", icon: "list", order: 10 });
    r.nav({
      id: "task-list",
      label: "task-board:nav.list",
      parent: "task-board:nav:tasks",
      screen: "task-board:screen:task-list",
      order: 10,
    });
    r.nav({
      id: "task-overdue",
      label: "task-board:nav.overdue",
      parent: "task-board:nav:tasks",
      screen: "task-board:screen:task-overdue",
      order: 20,
    });
    r.nav({
      id: "task-workload",
      label: "task-board:nav.workload",
      parent: "task-board:nav:tasks",
      screen: "task-board:screen:task-workload",
      order: 30,
    });
  });
}
```
